hash_domain: git blob payload as stored in the repository (LF). SHA-256 of `git cat-file -p HEAD:<path>` bytes. Not Windows CRLF reconstruction. Not git SHA-1 blob id.
canonicalization: revision_sha256 = SHA-256 of canonical JSON (sort_keys, separators comma-colon, UTF-8, no NaN) of the filename-to-sha256 map, matching build_documents.py dig()/canon().
working_tree_note: On this Linux checkout, working-tree bytes equal git LF blobs for the hashed files (crlf_count=0).
